name: Potion of Climbing
summary: A potion that grants a Climb Speed and Advantage on climbing checks for 1 hour.

stats.effect:
When you drink this potion, you gain a {ref:glossary/climb-speed} equal to your {ref:glossary/speed} for 1 hour. During this time, you have {ref:glossary/advantage} on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb.

This potion is separated into brown, silver, and gray layers resembling bands of stone. Shaking the bottle fails to mix the colors.
